abyss-ink.$description: Abyss Ink — Page background, deepest surface — the void that everything floats on

deep-violet.$description: Deep Violet — Card and panel surfaces — one step lifted from the canvas; Atmospheric gradient overlay — blends canvas into indigo accent

twilight-plum.$description: Twilight Plum — Elevated surfaces, active nav backgrounds, deeper card variants

dark-plum.$description: Dark Plum — Hover states, inset surface, tooltip backgrounds

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Hairline borders with violet glow, decorative dividers

slate-violet.$description: Slate Violet — Muted borders, subdued dividers between sections

silver-lilac.$description: Silver Lilac — Secondary text, icon strokes, subdued labels

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Body text on dark surfaces, link text, standard icons

ghost-white.$description: Ghost White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

electric-indigo.$description: Electric Indigo — Brand accent — highlight testimonial card, gradient origin, decorative icon strokes; Signature gradient on hero text, highlight overlays, and brand energy

hot-magenta.$description: Hot Magenta — Brand accent — gradient terminus, star icons, playful tag fills

orchid-pink.$description: Orchid Pink — Medium pink — decorative chip backgrounds, gradient midtones

cotton-candy.$description: Cotton Candy — Soft pink wash — subtle accent surfaces, decorative tags

clash-grotesk.$description: Display and hero headlines — geometric and tight; 72px hero with line-height 1.00 creates near-architectural blocks. Free alternative: Space Grotesk or Migra.

satoshi.$description: Body, UI, buttons, navigation, subheadings, and section headings up to 48px. The 0.045em tracking gives it a slightly airy, contemporary feel at smaller sizes. Free alternative: Inter or General Sans.
